meta.title: Recreate Order with a different delivery location

plan.title: Recreate Order with Gurgaon Delivery Location

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary for the buyer-side recreate-order flow.
Open Recreate Order from the RFQ stage Settings menu.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order form, change Delivery location to Gurgaon, create the order, and verify the new event shows Gurgaon while the original closed RFQ remains unchanged

steps.note: Perform and verify the recreate-order form interaction, including the required delivery-location change and preservation of the original event.
Assert that the recreated event visibly contains the requested Gurgaon delivery location.
